_comment: The synthetic sharepoint-claims corpus, pre-chunked by heading (see app/connectors/documents.py). The refund and approval sentences are docs/runtime-contract.md §3.3's own example and the golden questions' policy fact; `etag` is what a citation's version comes from.

documents.body:
# Refund policy
Refund requests are reviewed by the claims team within five business days.

## Premium customers
Premium customers may receive a refund within 30 days.

# Approval policy
Claims above the adjuster's authority need a second signature.

## Large refunds
Refund requests over 100000 require manual approval by a claims manager.
